note: The homepage walkthrough: seven photographs of ONE made-up home, in chapter order. Every image is an AI-generated illustration made in Runway (Noah's workspace) on 2026-11-25. None is a real listing or a home we manage, and the homepage footer says so. Brief: a Southern charmer near Augusta, GA in the $350K-$600K range (about 2,800 sq ft, white painted brick, navy front door). `taskId` re-downloads the original from Runway; the files in masters/ are those originals as JPEG; where a scene says `retouched`, retouch.mjs made the master from the original (node scripts/tour/retouch.mjs <original.png> <id>). `id` must match the chapter's id in src/index.html. `focus` is where the walk-through zoom aims, as a fraction of the frame [x, y]. `portraitX` is the horizontal center of the phone crop. `wideCrop` [left, top, width] cuts the wide-screen photo from a 16:9 window of the master, and `pos` sets which part stays in view when a wide screen is narrower than 16:9 (0.5 = centered; default portraitX); the Handoff uses both so the keys hang in the open space between the copy and the form card. `drift` is the camera move while the room is on screen (in, out, left, right; see DRIFT in src/js/home.js). After any change: node scripts/tour/build.mjs
house: Two-story Southern traditional, white painted brick with white lap siding in the gable, black shutters, bronze metal porch roof, full front porch with square white columns, haint-blue porch ceiling, deep navy six-panel front door with brass hardware. Inside: medium-oak floors, soft white walls, white trim and plantation shutters, caramel leather, navy accents, brass lamps.
